title: Generative AI Engineering Intern
description: Build LLM-powered agents that call tools and answer questions over company documents. You will design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, write prompts with structured JSON outputs and evaluate answer quality. Requirements: Python, LangChain or LangGraph, embeddings and a vector database.

title: NLP Research Intern
description: Fine-tune transformer language models for text classification and summarisation in Indian languages. Run experiments, track metrics and write evaluation reports. Requirements: Python, PyTorch, basics of NLP and transformers.

title: Backend Developer Intern (Python)
description: Ship REST APIs for a fintech product using FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Design tables, write efficient SQL queries, add tests and deploy services with Docker. Requirements: Python, SQL, REST API design.

title: Node.js Backend Intern
description: Build and maintain Express.js microservices for an e-commerce platform. Work with MongoDB, Redis caching and JWT authentication. Requirements: JavaScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB.

title: Frontend Developer Intern (React)
description: Build responsive React interfaces with Tailwind CSS, reusable components and accessible design. Integrate REST APIs and improve page performance. Requirements: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern (MERN)
description: Own features end to end on a student community platform built with MongoDB, Express, React and Node.js. Implement authentication, dashboards and real-time chat. Requirements: MERN stack, REST APIs, Git.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyse sales data with SQL, build Power BI dashboards and present weekly insights to category managers. Requirements: strong SQL, Excel, Power BI or Tableau.

title: Product Analyst Intern
description: Define product metrics, run A/B test analysis and write SQL to understand rider behaviour. Requirements: SQL, statistics, Tableau or similar BI tool.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Build batch and streaming data pipelines with Apache Spark, Airflow and Kafka. Model data warehouse tables and monitor pipeline reliability. Requirements: Python, SQL, Spark basics.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Train and evaluate deep learning models on medical imaging and tabular health data. Build training pipelines in PyTorch and report model metrics. Requirements: Python, PyTorch, machine learning fundamentals.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Build crop yield prediction models with pandas and scikit-learn, perform feature engineering and communicate findings to agronomists. Requirements: Python, pandas, scikit-learn, statistics.

title: Computer Vision Intern
description: Develop object detection and tracking for warehouse robots using OpenCV and PyTorch. Optimise models for edge devices. Requirements: Python, OpenCV, deep learning basics.

title: MLOps Intern
description: Deploy and monitor machine learning and LLM services in production. Containerise models with Docker, manage Kubernetes jobs and build evaluation dashboards. Requirements: Python, Docker, cloud basics.

title: Search & Recommendations Intern
description: Improve product search and personalised recommendations. Work on semantic search with embeddings, ranking models, retrieval evaluation (recall, nDCG) and A/B tests. Requirements: Python, SQL, information retrieval basics.

title: DevOps Intern
description: Automate CI/CD pipelines, manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS and write Terraform infrastructure as code. Requirements: Linux, Docker, scripting, AWS basics.

title: Cloud Engineer Intern (GCP)
description: Help migrate services to Google Cloud, set up monitoring and manage containerised workloads. Requirements: Linux, Docker, any cloud certification is a plus.

title: Flutter Mobile Developer Intern
description: Build cross-platform mobile app screens in Flutter and Dart for a fitness tracking app. Integrate REST APIs and Firebase. Requirements: Dart, Flutter.

title: Android Developer Intern
description: Develop native Android features in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose for a payments app. Requirements: Kotlin, Android SDK.

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: Assist with vulnerability assessment and penetration testing of web applications, analyse security logs and write incident reports. Requirements: networking, Linux, OWASP Top 10 knowledge.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description: Design wireframes, prototypes and design systems in Figma. Conduct user research and usability tests. Requirements: Figma, a design portfolio.

title: QA Automation Intern
description: Write automated UI and API tests with Selenium and pytest, and maintain test pipelines. Requirements: Python or Java, testing fundamentals.

title: Java Backend Intern
description: Build microservices with Java and Spring Boot, write MySQL queries and REST APIs for an insurance platform. Requirements: Java, OOP, SQL.

title: Backend Engineer Intern (Go)
description: Build high-throughput backend services in Go for real-time vehicle tracking, using PostgreSQL and Kafka. Requirements: any backend language, SQL, willingness to learn Go.

title: Blockchain Developer Intern
description: Write and test Solidity smart contracts and build dApp frontends. Requirements: Solidity basics, JavaScript.

title: Game Developer Intern
description: Prototype gameplay mechanics in Unity with C# for mobile games. Requirements: Unity, C#.

title: Embedded Systems Intern
description: Write firmware in C and C++ for microcontrollers in EV battery management systems. Requirements: C, electronics basics.

title: Mechanical Design Intern
description: Create 3D CAD models and drawings in SolidWorks and AutoCAD for turbine components, and support manufacturing process documentation. Requirements: production or mechanical engineering student.

title: Supply Chain Analyst Intern
description: Analyse production planning and inventory data for a manufacturing plant, build Excel models and improve procurement workflows. Requirements: industrial or production engineering background, Excel.

title: Technical Writer Intern
description: Write API documentation, tutorials and release notes for developer tools. Requirements: clear writing, basic programming knowledge.

title: Conversational AI Intern
description: Build customer support chatbots with LLMs, function calling and conversation memory. Measure response quality with automated evals and human review. Requirements: Python, prompt engineering, APIs.
